name: Smith Machine Lunge
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Stand tall, then sit down slowly and stand back up.
start_cue.hi: Seedhe khade ho, phir dheere baitho aur upar aao.

good.en: Good. You went down low enough.

fix.en: Go lower. Take your hips down between your feet.
fix.hi: Neeche jao. Hips pairon ke beech le jao.

above.en: Go lower. Take your hips down between your feet.
above.hi: Neeche jao. Hips pairon ke beech le jao.

below.en: That is very deep. Come up until your thighs are level.
below.hi: Yeh bahut neeche hai. Upar aao jab tak jaanghein level aayein.

almost.en: Go lower. Take your hips down between your feet.
almost.hi: Neeche jao. Hips pairon ke beech le jao.

good.en: Good. You stood all the way up.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aap poore khade ho gaye.

fix.en: Stand all the way up and straighten your legs.
fix.hi: Poora khade ho jao aur pairn seedhe karo.

almost.en: Stand all the way up and straighten your legs.
almost.hi: Poora khade ho jao aur pairn seedhe karo.

fix.en: Your chest is falling. Keep it up as you sit down.
fix.hi: Chest gir raha hai. Neeche baithte time chest upar rakho.

almost.en: Your chest is falling. Keep it up as you sit down.
almost.hi: Chest gir raha hai. Neeche baithte time chest upar rakho.

fix.en: Too fast. Control the way down and count 2.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Neeche control karo aur 2 gino.

above.en: Very slow. Good control — keep moving smoothly.
above.hi: Bahut slow hai. Control achha hai, smooth chalte raho.

below.en: Too fast. Control the way down and count 2.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Neeche control karo aur 2 gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.
